_metadata.title: SOCDOF Custom Language Pack Template
_metadata.instructions: Translate the string values into your desired language. Keep the keys unchanged. Save as a .json file and import via Settings -> Language & Region.
_metadata.author: User / Community

translations.app.name: SOCDOF
translations.app.tagline: Strudel's Organization, Commerce & Documentation Offline Flow
translations.app.subtitle: 100% Local Windows Desktop ERP Suite

translations.desc.fleet: Vehicle management, tax-compliant digital logbook, fuel logs & mileage analytics

translations.desc.appstore: Activate, pin, and configure system modules
translations.desc.calendar: Google Calendar live 2-way sync, appointments & invoice due dates
translations.desc.docs: Complete user guide and workflow documentation
translations.desc.settings: Company data, letterhead, colors, and JSON backups
translations.desc.widgets: Desktop widgets and floating sticky notes
translations.lang_modal.title: Choose Your Language
translations.lang_modal.subtitle: Select your preferred language for the SOCDOF Desktop Suite. You can change this anytime in Language Settings.
translations.lang_modal.skip_hint: You can skip and continue with English.
translations.lang_modal.sample_hint: Quick Start & Interactive Demo available in top bar
translations.settings.title: SOCDOF Settings
translations.settings.personalization_desc: Customize appearance, system accent colors, and desktop window effects.
translations.settings.mica_desc: Subtle blur and translucent titlebars for a native desktop feel.
translations.settings.desktop_icon_blur: Frosted Glass behind Desktop App Icons
translations.settings.desktop_icon_blur_desc: Adds a soft frosted blur under desktop app icons for maximum contrast on busy backgrounds (disabled by default for crystal sharpness).
translations.settings.accent_system_desc: Instantly applied across window headers, buttons, badges, and the taskbar.
translations.settings.picasso_desc: Freely choose and customize any system accent color
translations.settings.taskbar_desc: Choose the appearance and style of the bottom taskbar.
translations.settings.font_scale_desc: Adjust the system font size smoothly (90% to 130%).
translations.settings.wallpaper_desc: Choose a custom background image for your workspace or use the default gradient.
translations.settings.company_data_desc: Manage company name, address, tax ID, and contact information for invoices.
translations.settings.lang_region_desc: Choose your display language, date format, and currency.
translations.settings.keyboard_layout_desc: Choose how shortcut key combinations are displayed (Strg vs Ctrl vs ⌘ Cmd).
translations.settings.keyboard_layout_auto_desc: German = Strg (QWERTZ), English/French/Spanish = Ctrl (QWERTY), macOS = ⌘ Cmd
translations.settings.keyboard_layout_strg_desc: Displays Strg+K, Strg+S, Strg+Space across all menus and tooltips

translations.settings.keyboard_layout_cmd_desc: Displays ⌘K, ⌘S, ⌘Space across all menus and tooltips
translations.connections.title: Connections, Google Calendar & Integrations
translations.connections.desc: Connect SOCDOF with Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, or Apple Calendar.
translations.connections.gcal_desc: Exports due dates of all invoices, customer appointments, and custom agenda items.
translations.connections.download_ics_desc: Opens directly in Google Calendar, Outlook, Thunderbird, or Apple Calendar.
translations.connections.import_ics_desc: Import external appointments or tasks from an .ics file directly into SOCDOF.
translations.connections.rest_api_desc: Allows offline data exchange with external accounting and inventory systems without cloud lock-in.
translations.connections.import_empty: No valid events found in the uploaded .ics file.
translations.windows.codesign_desc: Sign .exe binaries with developer identity (Yuri / Strudel) to satisfy Windows SmartScreen.
translations.windows.smartscreen_hint: Newly generated executables can be signed with Authenticode. Installing the developer certificate to Trusted Root eliminates all warning prompts.
translations.backup.wizard_desc: Would you like to enable automatic local backups to protect your invoices, contacts, and accounting records regularly?
translations.backup.default_desc: Backups are stored by default in your local browser Downloads directory or can be pointed to any directory of your choice (e.g. hard drive, USB stick).
translations.backup.note_change_later: You can change this anytime in Settings > Backup & Storage.

translations.backup.path_placeholder: Default: Local Downloads directory (or click Choose Folder)
translations.status.storage_tooltip: Local database storage footprint used by records in browser IndexedDB
translations.settings.master_volume_desc: Adjust acoustic loudness for all POS checkouts, clicks, notifications, and chimes.
translations.settings.sound_payment_success_desc: Sparkling coin cascade & 5-tone celebratory chime for POS checkouts & paid invoices
translations.settings.sound_nfc_desc: Fast electronic double-beep for debit, credit cards, or smartphone taps
translations.settings.sound_drawer_desc: Mechanical bass slide and spring latch sound when opening the cash drawer
translations.settings.sound_coin_desc: Pure double coin ring for change calculation and coin trays
translations.settings.sound_bell_desc: Traditional brass reception and table order chime
translations.settings.sound_kaching_desc: Classic vintage cash register register bell

translations.settings.sound_trash_desc: Subtle paper crumple and shred sound for record deletion
translations.settings.sound_lock_desc: Secure mechanical lock latch when locking the screen or vault
translations.settings.sound_unlock_desc: Clean latch release when logging in or unlocking workstation
translations.settings.lang_packs_title: Custom Language Packs & JSON Translation Editor
translations.settings.lang_packs_desc: Customize system terminology or translate SOCDOF into any language locally. Export the JSON template, edit the strings, and import your pack.
translations.settings.lang_download_template_desc: Exports all English translation keys and descriptions ready for editing in VS Code, Notepad, or any editor.
translations.settings.lang_import_pack_desc: Load an external JSON language pack into your local installation.
translations.settings.lang_electron_folder_hint: Windows Desktop Offline Folder: You can also place custom .json files in %APPDATA%/socdof/languages/ for automatic desktop loading.
